chapters: Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x oi'ñga' gook gu Dariio ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Sakariias jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu mar gu Berekîas gu mar gu Iddo bham.
Jano' ba' bhaam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx daak bhaan tattat.
Jano' ba' daipu'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.

Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p tattat jix maa jiiñak dharka' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jano' tomaat gu bhóogɨt buimɨi; jano' ba' cham tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tattat duukat jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' duaka' na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan cham jix duñia' tattat gu Por gu ñi'ook suulh gui'p; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt buimɨi jix duu bɨɨx no'ch.
Jano' ba' maakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sebat oi'ñga' gook gu Dariio ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Sakariias jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu mar gu Berekîas gu mar gu Iddo bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tukaa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ jix duñia' bhaan kavaayo ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk ka't; gio ba' ka't jix duñia' jix toja.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook suulhgia' gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa' nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook suulhgia'.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bɨx gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bɨɨx ka'm duuk cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Jerusalem jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa bɨɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' duuñ bham; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; jano' ba' gu Jerusalem gu Sioon bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' bhaan chɨbɨɨp; na gu' tu' ka't jix bhai'x na ba' cham bhai'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Jerusalem bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr ka't gu vaak tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ ka't bhaan gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' duuñ gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jɨ'dɨlh xoi'kam; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Sioon gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui maakobh a'aa'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' suulhgia' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam a'aa' gu ñi'ook gu Judaa gu Israeel gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios maakobh.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jupaabkamu'n suulhgia' a'ga jix aa' bham; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam a'aa' gu ñi'ook gu Judaa mo'o; gu' suulhgia' jix duñia' tɨbiap na ba' jix duñia' na ba' a'aa' chɨbɨɨp bhaan gu oidha' gu Judaa na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi' dhɨr gu vupui gu chio'ñ ga'ra' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' duukat jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Jerusalem na ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam busaak mii' dhɨr nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk nobii'ñ jix buus.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook dhi' bham; mi' dhɨr cham vaak jodai ka't gu Jerusalem kuiñcha gu chichio'ñ gu vaakax tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' na ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios vaak jodai gu tai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gɇ'kamtu'nda' tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios maakobh jɨbɨɨlh gu tɨkɨr gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Sioon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx mar u'vɨ gu Babiloonia.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp; na gu' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu novɨ bhaan ka't tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bhañ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mar u'vɨ gu Sioon; na gu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mumua'da' chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh ka't gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa gu maa'nkar gu oidha' abhaar gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' abhaar gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu Mostroome gu Josuee jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't vupui bhaan nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Sataan ka't gu novɨ tu jiim na ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Sataan; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Sataan; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu Jerusalem tu'; jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee ka't tɨi'chu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't vupui bhaan nobii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi'p vupui bhaan bham; gio ba' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook kutun.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na jix bhai' bhaan mo'o; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas bhaan mo'o; jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josuee bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt tu' nukadham jir bɨx bhai' gio tu' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu vaak gio tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' ja'tkam tu' ɨrban.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu Josuee jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' vupui bhaan tu'; na gu' gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu Miren tu' tu duukam gu Pimpollo.

Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu jodai vupui bhaan gu Josuee; gio ba' bhaan dhi' gu jodai cham tu'x jai'ch kɨɨv gu vupui; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ uañi'ñ gu oidha' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt duiñchu' bɨtaa'n iigɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Bolbioo nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' na ja'p gu chio'ñ.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu jiim mɨichdhai bɨx jix uam jodai bɨɨx vaaso bhaan mo'o kɨɨv tɨtɨɨya tu jiim mɨichdhai; jano' ba' kɨɨv na ba' tɨtɨɨya tu jiim.
Jano' ba' bhaan gook gu ñi'ook tu jiim vaaso o'nsop.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham ñɨidhat gu ñi'ook dhi' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham gu Jawatan.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Sorobabeel tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham tu' bɨɨx gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu Sorobabeel ka'; gio ba' gu jodai bɨɨx gu Grakia nɨidhidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' bham.
Jano' ba' gu noobh gu Sorobabeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dhi' gu vaak gu noobh gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bhañ bhaan.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Sorobabeel; gio ba' mii' dhɨr kɨɨv gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' gook gu ñi'ook tu jiim mɨichdhai o'nsop.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix vɨɨk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gook mamraga'n gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook jix uam jodai bɨ'ñdhatu' na ja'p jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix aa' bham; gio ba' cham ñɨidhat gu ñi'ook dhi' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gook gu ma'nkam bɨ'ñdhatu' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu Torneeme gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr da'a gu ñi'ook jix duñia' mambhɨɨx.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' dhi' mu'ai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu oidha'; na gu' bɨx mii' dhɨr jix duñia' na ja'p baasɨ'n ka't; jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na ja'p baasɨ'n ka't.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ ɨlhdham gu vaak ɨxkum gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak bɨɨx gu jodai.
Ba' jix aa' jix buus mii' dhɨr nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jano' gu vupui gu ñi'ook dhi'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Epa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' gu vupui bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ' maa'nkar jodai gu u'vɨ ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr gu Epa.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' dhi' gu Maldad; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Epa jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chin.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gook gu u'vɨ jix buus gu ñi'ook gu jɨvɨl ko'kmarak na ja'p gu Epa tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook nobii'ñ ua'rgidhimɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' duukat gu ux na tu ibai' gu Epa.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; na ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu oidha' gu Sinar; mi' dhɨr ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Torneeme gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui maakobh jix buus tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook gu kakkavɨk; gio ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu kakkavɨk jix duñia' gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't kavaayo gook kavaayo.
Jano' ba' vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo jix toja maakobh kavaayo gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ua'rgidhimɨk; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook dhi'.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam maakobh jɨbɨɨlh gu tɨkɨr gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ pai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' mi'p kavaayo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam moor bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' jix toja moor bhaan; mi' dhɨr moor bhaan gu oidha' saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam moor tu' gu oidha'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu oidha'; jano' ba' pai'.
Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt bham; gio ba' gu Mira moor bhaan gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' gu Toma gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu eldai gu Tobiias gu Jedaiia suulh gu Babiloonia; gio ba' ɨlhdham tu' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh ba'k gu vaak gu Josiiyas gu mar gu Sepaniias.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix toja jodai jix uam jodai jix duu gu jodai' na jix uam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Josuee gu mar gu Josadak.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bham; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Pimpollo pai' gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' atooxkor ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook.
Jano' ba' gu elem gu Tobiias gu Jedaiia gu en gu mar gu Sepaniias jix duñia' gu jodai' na jix uam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam aajim gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ tu' bhaan; gio ba' ka't dhi' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't oi'ñga' maakobh gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Sakariias maakobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu Kisleu.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Saraser bɨɨx gu Regem-melek gu chichio'ñ gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ñiokda' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan mi'p gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jixchamaam chulhiiñchuda' na ja'p gu ñi'ook tu' dhɨt.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bham; na pai' dhuuk jixchamaam kɨɨv dhi' ja'tkam jix duñia' na ba' tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham na ba'.
Na pai' dhuuk cham dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan dharka' na pai' dhuuk gu Jerusalem ka't jɨ'dɨlh xikoolh saagi'ñ vaak ja'tkam oi'ñka'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Sakariias bham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jir bhai' jir bɨx bhai' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch jix duñia' bɨɨx xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tu' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam tu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr tu' gampai'; gio ba' tu' cham bhai' gu i'ii'ñ bhaan xibhɨk.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kai va'k jix maa maatɨt na ba' cham.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p jodai na jix kavɨk na ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan dharka'; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' sɨlhka'n gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p tu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' cham gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨx chɨbɨɨp cham jix maati' gu oidha' ka't bhaan cham jum duu tu'; na gu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sioon bɨɨx jix gɨ' bɨɨx jix gɨ' daak.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sioon tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr gu Jerusalem tɨɨt gu Kiudad gu Berdad gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu kavɨk gu Santidad.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' kɨklhi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu novɨ gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham ka't jix bhuup gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' tu' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui dhi' gu ja'tkam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh gio ka't vupui bhaan gu vupui tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu Miren tu' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' tas buusñi gu oidha' pai' jix duñia' gu tas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jerusalem; gio ba' ka't gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx tu'r bɨɨx bɨx bhai'.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh dhi' gu ñi'ook gu chin jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan dɨr gu tanoolh gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ na ba' gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.

Na gu' na gu' va'k dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ tu' gu vaakax tu' ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ na ba' ba'k tu' na ba' kuiñcha bhaamki'ñdha'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhaan duiñchu'.
Gu' gu' jano' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam na ja'p mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kai' bhai'x i'ii'ñ; gio ba' maa'n gu i'bhɨ maa'n gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu tɨkɨr; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu ja'tkam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨx dhi'.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mu'ai tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Judaa gu vaak gu Israeel dodhia' boopoya' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' gu' gu noobh.
Na gu' na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; na pai' dhuuk na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' cham bhai' na pai' dhuuk tattat daak tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem gu vaak gu Judaa dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu'x jix duñia' duñia'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook tu'r bɨɨx tɨtmo; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiki'ñgob tu'r ñi'ook na jir bhai' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' gu i'ii'ñ bhaan tɨtmo tu' kai'chɨt gu ñi'ook ɨɨxi'ñdha'; na gu' bɨx dhi' tu'x tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maakobh jixchamaam kɨɨv gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Judaa bhai' ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu'r bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam aajim gu ja'tkam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n mumua'da' jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' aajim gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' gio tu jiim.
Jano' ba' aajim mui'x gu ja'tkam jix kavɨk gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ bɨx ñiiñio'k chɨbɨɨp gu Judiio bham; na gu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na gu' naak gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu oidha' gu adrak gu Damasko jɨɨpi'ñka'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu chichio'ñ bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gio gu amat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Tiro gu Sidoon gu bhóogɨt ka't.
Jano' ba' jix duu xoi'kam gu Tiro gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai na ja'p oo' jix uam jodai na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai' gu kavɨk ka't gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu Askaloon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Gasa gio; na gu' gu Ekroon na gu' nɨɨra ka't; jano' ba' gu Gasa gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Askaloon cham ka't.
Jano' ba' jix daa gu Asdod ja'tkam mii' dhɨr tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Palestinos.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr gu chin taatam gu ñi'ook gio na ba' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios ka't na ja'p gu Judaa gu Ekroon na ja'p gu Jebuseo.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' vaak ja'tkam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu vaak kuiñcha tu' jupaabkamu'n; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan; na gu' jano' bɨɨx gu vupui.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jai' mar u'vɨ gu Sioon; gio ba' jix maa jiiñak mar u'vɨ gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' ɨlhdham tu' jir bhai' boosolh jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan bhuru'x gu mar gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Epraim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ chɨbɨɨp; jano' ba' aapi' ka't gu gɨ' suudai' dɨr gɨ' suudai' jiim bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr ñi'ook na jix bhaan ka' dodhia'; gio ba' tu' jix buusñi ui'ka' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook ui'ka' nɨɨra; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gio.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu' gu Judaa na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu Epraim; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu Sioon bhaan gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu Grekia tu' na ja'p gu kuchii jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't buupui bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk tu' na ja'p.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai i'i jix duu na ja'p suudai' u'va; gio ba' jix bhuup na ja'p jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' u'ua'tɨda' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p kakneer gu ja'tkam; na gu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' na ja'p gu jodai kuruun.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam joi'gɨ'nda' tiriik biipibop suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios dhuuk gu tanoolh na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios maa'n dhuuk jix duñia' gu vaas yooxi' maa'n.

Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook jix duñia' buupui gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tɨɨtki' gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; na gu' jix bɨɨx duu na ja'p kakneer jix bɨɨx duu na gu' cham chooto'n bipia'dam.
Jano' ba' bhaan bipia'dam tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiiw; gu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ jix duñia' kakneer gu vaak gu Judaa na ja'p kavaayo gɨ'x bhai' bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham gio bɨx.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jix kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaamki'ñdha'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.

Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Judaa gu vaak gu Josee; na gu' gu ñi'ook na gu' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr ka't na ja'p tu' cham jix bhai'x; na gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Epraim na ja'p jix kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p suudai' u'va; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gio jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu'; gio ba' ka't na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' xoi'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam tu'; gio ba' na jix do'ig bɨɨx gu ma'nkam.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu Asiria; gio ba' gu oidha' gu Galaad gu Liibano cham.
Jano' ba' chulhiiñ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook bɨx gɨ' suudai' jiim; gio ba' gu Assur ka't gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨɨgɨ' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Liibano gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiki'ñgob gu tai gɨ' u'u kavɨk.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't na gu' gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu'; na gu' gu Basaan na gu' jix kavɨk gu kavɨk.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bipia'dam na gu' gɨ'x bhai'; na gu' gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook kakneer gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' mu'aa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ko'kmarak jix duñia'; gio ba' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' chɨtda; mi' dhɨr ka't gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' tu' bipia'dam ko'kmarak jix duñia'.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix duñia' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' kapbhai' gu chichio'ñ gu novɨ duiñchu' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' tu' cham gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer gu ñi'ook maachim bia' kakneer; gio ba' gook; mi' dhɨr maa'n gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Suabidad gu Ataduras; jano' ba' kakneer.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kooda' vaik bipia'dam gu i'ii'ñ gio gu i'ii'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na vaak jodai; jano' ba' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Suabidad na ba' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh jix maati' bia' kakneer tu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr tu' cham tɨtda:―Cha'pim; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' u'uuk bɨɨx jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ataduras na ba' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Judaa tu' gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bipia'dam gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bipia'dam gu oidha' cham jix duñia' cham gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n cham tu'; gu' gu ñi'ook jugi gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' cham bhai' ka't bipia'dam cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaakax; gio ba' gu kuchii bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan gu vupui gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ka't gu vupui gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios muuk gu tɨkɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu Jerusalem vaaso gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' bɨx gu ja'tkam xikoolh na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Judaa bhaan gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem gu jodai bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook ka't xoi'kam bɨx chɨbɨɨp gu oidha' bhaan.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨx kavaayo bɨɨx jix duñia'; gu' bhaan gu vaak gu Judaa bhi'spio'kai gu vupui bɨx kavaayo gu ja'tkam bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu kavɨk gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tai gu u'u na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tai; gio ba' kɨɨ'n bɨx gu ja'tkam xikoolh; mi' dhɨr gu Jerusalem ka't jix duñia' pai' gu Jerusalem.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios vaak zel gu Judaa maa'n na gu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu vaak gu Dabii gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem cham bhaan gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ua'tulhi'ñ mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't na ja'p gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu vaak gu Dabii na ja'p daada' na ja'p nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx chɨbɨɨp bhaan gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan gu vaak gu Dabii bhaan gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ nɨidhidha' soi'm; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan jix duu gu ñi'ook bhaan na ja'p gu ñi'ook bhaan na ja'p bhaan maa'nkam mar.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu Adadrimoon gu Megiddo.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu vaak gu Dabii gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu vaak gu Nataan gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu vaak gu Lebii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simei gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix kupi'ook na ba' gu vaak gu Dabii na ba' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem na ba' uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu tɨɨgɨ' cham pai' dhuuk aajim chɨ'ñchoka'; gio ba' gio jix duñia' gu oidha' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu taat gu naan jix mar; na gu' cham ii'mdagaram na gu' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk gu taat gu naan jix mar na pai' dhuuk.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' cham pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham jix duñia' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oidha'; na gu' dhi' gu chio'ñ dɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx jix duñia' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' bamii' gu ñi'ook gu kuchii bhaan bipia'dam bhaan gu chio'ñ duiñchu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' bipia'dam kakneer; gu' gu novɨ bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu oidha' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gook ka't; gu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai baasɨ'n na ja'p jix toja jodai na ja'p jix uam jodai; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' tu jiim; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam; jano' ba'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios jupaabkamu'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx chɨbɨɨp bhaan gu Jerusalem; gio ba' kiicham ka't gu vaak gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham gu' gu ja'tkam cham ka't kiicham.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx mii' dhɨr chɨbɨɨp na ja'p gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tɨɨt mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh bhaan gu kavɨk gu Olibas jix bhai'x gu Jerusalem baasɨ'n tas buusñi; gio ba' gu kavɨk gu Olibas jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan tas buusñi bhaan tas gei'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ'; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan saagi'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakkavɨk; na gu' gu kakkavɨk bɨɨx ka'm gu asal; mi' dhɨr kuiñcha gi'ndukɨ gu tanoolh gu Ussiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; jano' ba' ɨlhdham gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx jɨɨgi'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh cham gu tasi' tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't gu tanoolh tu' gu tukaa'; gu' gu ñi'ook gu xumai gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jerusalem gu suudai'; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' gu ux na tu ibai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu gɨ'kora' bhaan bɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios ka't maa'n gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p dɨr gu Gabaa bɨɨx ka'm gu Rimmoon saagi'ñ gu Jerusalem; gio ba' ka't jix daa tu' pai' dɨr ki'ñgob gu Benjamiin bɨɨx ka'm pai' ki'ñgob bɨɨx ka'm ki'ñgob; mi' dhɨr dɨr bhi'ñbak gu ananeel bɨɨx ka'm gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham pai' dhuuk ka't; gu' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jerusalem jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ja'tkam bhaan gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu chuukug kua' bhaan tɨɨt gu vupui nɨɨn gu chin.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' maa'n gu novɨ duiñchu' gu novɨ bhaan gu novɨ duiñchu'.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem; gio ba' ka't namkɨm bɨx chɨbɨɨp xikoolh; mi' dhɨr jix uam jodai jix toja jodai kutun jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' na ja'p dhi' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo jix ai gu ñi'ook bɨx gu vaakax mii' dhɨr ja'tkam vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp tɨɨtɨs bhaan gu Jerusalem jix tɨ'ɨ oi'ñga' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Kabañas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak gu oidha' cham gu Jerusalem jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ cham ɨlhdham bhaan dhuuk.
Jano' ba' tu' ja'tkam vaak gu Ejipto cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham daraibu' bhaan cham dhuuk; gio ba' ɨlhdham bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios chɨbɨɨp cham gu ñi'ook gu Kabañas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ gu Ejipto uañi'ñ bɨx chɨbɨɨp cham gu ñi'ook gu Kabañas.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan vaak ja'tkam kavaayo; gio ba' jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't na ja'p vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' ka't bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem gu Judaa jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' bɨx maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan aajim jix bhɨɨ; mi' dhɨr cham gu Kananeo oi'ñdha' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
